overview: Google launched its Project Suncatcher prototype satellite, which carries four TPUs, on SpaceX's Transporter-18 rideshare. Elon Musk revised the memory plans for Tesla's AI5 and AI6 chips. There was also a lot of AI model and tooling news: Gemini 4 Argon benchmarks, Coinbase's agent trading skill, Microsoft's cheaper voice model on Vercel, and Cloudflare's Clef decision models.

top_items.title: GoogleAI - Project Suncatcher prototype with four TPUs reaches orbit on SpaceX Transporter-18 to test ML compute in space
elonmusk - Tesla cut AI5 chip RAM to 72GB, then nudged it up to 96GB; AI6 drops to 144GB to reach Optimus production volume
demishassabis - Shared Artificial Analysis finding that Gemini 4 Argon matches GPT-6 Astra on its index at 60% of the cost per task
karpathy - Ask LLMs for ASD-STE100 plain writing, diagrams, HTML pages or custom explainer videos to understand outputs faster
brian_armstrong - Coinbase skill lets your AI agent view your portfolio, trade crypto, stocks and derivatives, and pay for data via x402
steipete - Flagged a report of 'several vulnerabilities' in the Linux kernel
mustafasuleyman - Microsoft AI voice and streaming transcription models launch on Vercel, which he claims are 60% cheaper than ElevenLabs
steipete - Cloudflare releases two self-trained decision models, Clef and Clef-flash; he says he's never seen an idea spread so fast
